clips.title: The story
paras: Deino seeks a sample from the waters of Xavian, deep in Ashenvale. The troll mage hopes to study the ancient city's lingering arcane power, and sends her apprentice to draw water from its highest waterfall.

Deino, a troll mage in Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits, searches Kalimdor for traces of primal arcane energy. Her attention turns to Xavian, an ancient night elf city hidden beneath Ashenvale's eastern canopy. Scholars say the city held great magical knowledge before the Sundering. Its waters are believed to retain arcane power that modern mages hope to understand.

Xavian lies in ruins, overrun by feral, corrupt satyrs who defend their ground from outsiders. To reach the water, you travel past Satyrnaar and through dangerous waterways, avoiding prowling beasts and demonic sentinels. Deino needs a sample from the pool at the base of the city's highest waterfall.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The fabled city of Xavian lies nestled deep within eastern Ashenvale, and tales of its ancient knowledge are well known among the learned. It is said that the waters of Xavian hold vast magical powers.
I would have a sample of those waters, from their source.

Take this flask and go to Xavian. Gather water from the bottom of its highest waterfall, and return to me. And use care as you move through that ancient city--satyrs now hold the ruins and do not like mages prying into their affairs.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I am pleased you have returned with your skin intact, friend. Do you have the water sample? I am eager to study its properties.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, very good. I trust the satyrs of Xavian gave you little trouble?
Thank you, friend. I will study this sample of Xavian water immediately.
